newsitem.title: ESTONIA: HUVITUSFOND SEES 100 MLN KROON 1997 PROFIT.
newsitem.headline: HUVITUSFOND SEES 100 MLN KROON 1997 PROFIT.

text.p: Huvitusfond (Compensation Fund) said on Wednesday it estimates its 1997 profit to grow to 100 million kroons from 63.5 million kroons in 1996.
Huvitusfond posted a profit of 41.86 million kroons in the first quarter.
Huvitusfond said it estimated that its assets would grow to 1.65 billion kroons in 1997 compared to 1.075 billion kroons at the beginning of the year, it added in a statement.
Administrative costs in 1997 are estimated at 15 million kroons versus 11 million in 1996.
Huvitusfond sees investment revenues at 45 million kroons in 1997 compared to 12.4 million kroons in 1996.
Net interest revenues are estimated to grow from 61 million kroons in 1996 to 70 million kroons in 1997.
